claims.claim: Analog Devices fiscal Q3 2026 revenue reached a record $4.02B, with year-over-year growth led by Data Center and Industrial.
Trailing-12-month operating cash flow was $5.5B and free cash flow $4.9B, or 40% and 36% of revenue, respectively.
ADI completed its $1.5B Empower Semiconductor acquisition in July 2026, expanding grid-to-core power-delivery capability for AI compute where power density and efficiency are scaling constraints.

risks.risk: Analog and industrial demand remains cyclical; current growth can include recovery effects.
Empower adds acquisition integration and execution risk; strategic AI power exposure does not by itself establish economic returns.

unknowns.unknown: Organic contribution and customer concentration of specific AI/data-center power products are not isolated in these sources.

claims.claim: Execution remains strong across growth and cash conversion, with record Q3 revenue and a 36% trailing free-cash-flow margin.

The Empower acquisition creates a concrete AI power-delivery execution test: ADI must translate the acquired IVR/silicon-capacitor capability into durable design wins and profitable growth rather than only TAM expansion.

risks.risk: Recovery-driven comparisons may overstate steady-state growth as inventory normalization matures.
Acquisition integration or slower hyperscaler adoption could delay expected AI power-delivery returns.

unknowns.unknown: Current valuation, acquisition return thresholds, and product-level Empower revenue contribution are not established here.
